name: Incorrigible Gambler
body:
You have long been a gambler, and greatly enjoy the toss of the dice and the jingle of coins exchanging hand.

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to Profession (gambling) and a +2 bonus to both Sense Motive and Bluff checks made in conjunction with a game of chance in which you are involved.
